title: Chefmakes' lawn mowers
description: This is a lawnmower mod I made because the sickle wasn't enough
body:
![First time doing this in blockbench, how did it turnout?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5837c0b8fb98569ec5ed6150b426656563e3dfbc.png)

For some reason there are no lawn mower mods even knowing that removing grass is a universally experienced paint among survival builders. And because I thought the sickle wasnt enough I decided to add them. This mod adds 2 lawn mowers; A normal item one you use, and a Ride on one which you can drive and is unironically pretty fast.
They are crafted like this

![yes it's red](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf0858a4302d8a19701dfc0891e967d27de32ed9.png)

![he kinda havin fun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79ebdbfae5c36733f8fe59ca41de2d529c898b6b.png)     

(ignore the icon I couldn't think of a better one. You'll see why if you saw the actual lawn mower design)

---
# Dependencies
Only geckolib and my animation engine
